source_binding.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring
verified_source_facts: Legacy Q_{T,T'} states satisfy |P|=|M|<=|N|<=1 and therefore use only 000,001,111 cardinality patterns.
M is a subset of Y0 complete to P union N, while P is anticomplete to N.
S(Q) is the union of all local representative vertices.
Legacy Z(T,T') is defined separately for 000,001,111 and equals empty in 111.
Q-admissibility is defined on S(Q) union Z(Q) with endpoint restrictions, forced Z colors, and global properness.
The legacy polynomial count uses local support <=3, bounded S(Q), polynomially many Q, and unique admissible completion from a support precoloring.
Lemma 7 is stated for P6-free graphs.
Lemma 10 is stated for P6-free graphs.

state_identity.note: The shortest-seed-path witness sigma=(s,s') is an auxiliary certificate, not part of semantic state identity and not an independent enumeration dimension.

rigidity_certificate.rule: There exists a canonical shortest p-to-n seed path p-s-s_prime-n with interior in S such that a-p-s-s_prime-n-b is an induced P6.
rigidity_certificate.certificate_choice: Use the lexicographically first shortest seed path under the fixed total order induced by the input encoding; certificate verification is polynomial.

connectivity_derivation: T and T_prime are nonempty because f(T),f(T_prime) are singleton-valued.
p has a seed neighbor in T and n has a seed neighbor in T_prime.
a is adjacent to p and b is adjacent to n.
Therefore every SPLIT4 support fragment attaches to the connected legacy seed S.
The union over all local fragments remains connected through S.

Z_SELECTOR.warning: Correctness of choosing empty Z is not promoted by schema closure; it must survive later raw representative-coverage and equivalence obligations.

CARRIER_COLOR_AND_ADMISSIBILITY.endpoint_rule: f'(p),f'(n) belong to [4] minus (f(T) union f(T_prime))
CARRIER_COLOR_AND_ADMISSIBILITY.attachment_carriers: No additional local color equation for a,b; their colors are enumerated as support colors and retained only when f union f' is proper on the precolored induced graph.

verifier_checks: p has a neighbor in T
n has a neighbor in T_prime
CONNECTIVITY_CONTRACT.theorem_target: G[S union S(Qhat)] connected for every admitted global state
CONNECTIVITY_CONTRACT.specification_derivation: Each nonempty local fragment is connected to S; union with connected S is connected.

parameters.t: number of relevant ordered type-pairs with t<=2^(2s)

POLYNOMIAL_BUDGET.certificate_enumeration_note: sigma is chosen canonically and verified, so it does not multiply the semantic state count; even explicit enumeration of at most s^2 seed pairs would remain an s-dependent factor.
POLYNOMIAL_BUDGET.fixed_seed_conclusion: n^{q(s)} with q(s)=14*2^(2s) is a valid crude explicit bound

future_raw_gate.scope_boundary: STOP before Lemma 7, Lemma 10, acceptability, or any later P6-free transfer.

first_killer_refinement.name: RAW_REPRESENTATIVE_COVERAGE
first_killer_refinement.statement: For every fixed extension c and every relevant bad pair (p,n), prove that the local branch selected by the construction is either a legacy COMMON111 state or a valid SPLIT4 state whose stored colors agree with c.
first_killer_refinement.reason: Raw Ext-equivalence alone may be too weak because a normal-subcase precoloring obtained by simply fixing support colors is automatically restrictive; representative coverage tests the actual replacement for the common-z selection step.

raw_soundness.obligation: Every extension of a generated raw normal subcase reconstructs an extension of P.

raw_completeness.obligation: Every extension c of P is captured by at least one globally assembled Qhat,f' raw normal subcase.

no_common_neighbor: choose a in N(p) intersect Y0 and b in N(n) intersect Y0
absence of common Y0 neighbor gives p-b and a-n nonedges
axiom (iv) plus p-a edge and p-b nonedge forces a-b nonedge
verified P7_CORRIDOR_RIGIDITY supplies the exact induced-P6 certificate

downstream_firewall.reason: Both lemmas are explicitly stated for P6-free graphs in Paper II; a raw SPLIT4 equivalence result cannot invoke them automatically on P7-free inputs.
